### Fear and the Reign of God
Author: Jon Payne
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fear-and-reign-god
Passage: Daniel 7:1-8
Points:
- Daniel's God-given dream of four grotesque beasts alarmed him, reflecting the frightening nature of worldly empires.
- Each monstrous creature symbolizes powerful earthly kingdoms characterized by pride, destruction, and cruelty.
- The intimidating powers and anti-Christian hostility of a fallen world can easily cause believers to fear.
- Daniel's vision looks beyond the terrifying beasts to the sovereign rule of the Ancient of Days.
- Christ will ultimately overcome every wicked power and preserve His people in His everlasting kingdom.

### Bible Pathway - Sept. 17, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-17-2010-11638178.html
Passage: Daniel 7:1-8
Points:
- Daniel’s vision presents earthly kingdoms from God's perspective, exposing their selfish ambition and savage cruelty.
- The churning sea driven by winds represents fallen humanity destabilized by pride and godless conflict.
- The successive beasts—a lion, bear, leopard, and a terrifying fourth creature—portray successive world empires.
- The little horn arising from the final beast represents an arrogant ruler who blasphemes God and oppresses the saints.
- All oppressive earthly rulers will be overthrown when Christ establishes His eternal and glorious kingdom.
